title: Creative Strategist
problem: Turn a vague ask into a sharp brief everyone can act on.
resp: Turn a business problem into a clear creative brief
Build narratives that work in English, Hindi and South Indian languages
Read results every week and drop what isn't working
Present your thinking with the math showing
must: 2+ years in strategy or planning at an agency or brand
A portfolio of outcomes, not only outputs
Comfort with CTR, CVR and share of voice
Sharp, simple written English
nice: Works in a South Indian language
metrics: Ideas that move the number they were meant to move.

title: Creative Writer
problem: Write lines people repeat, not lines people scroll past.
resp: Write hooks, scripts and captions for creator content
Adapt one idea across platforms without losing the point
Test two versions of every hook and keep the winner
Work with TBM Studio on shoot-day scripts
must: 1+ year writing for brands or creators
Equally sharp in English and Hinglish
A portfolio with live work
Takes edits without taking them personally
metrics: Hook retention in the first three seconds and save rates.

title: Social Media Executive
problem: Run brand pages people actually choose to follow.
resp: Plan and run monthly content calendars for two to three brand pages
Turn trends into posts within the same day, not the same week
Read page numbers every week and change what isn't working
Work with writers, designers and TBM Studio on every post
must: 1+ year running social media for brands or creators
Knows Instagram, YouTube and LinkedIn from the inside
Can explain why a post worked, with numbers
Organised enough to never miss a go-live
nice: Has grown a page from scratch
metrics: Reach, saves and follower growth on the pages you run.

title: Production Intern
problem: Learn how a shoot really runs, by running parts of one.
resp: Help plan shoots: locations, props, call sheets
Track budgets and vendor bills
Be on set and keep the shoot day on time
Log and hand over footage to post-production
must: Curious about how ads and content get made
Organised and quick on follow-ups
Happy to be on set, on your feet
Available for 6 months, in office
nice: Has shot or assisted on any shoot, even a college one
metrics: Shoot days that start and wrap on time.

title: Influencer Relations Intern
problem: Learn how a creator campaign really runs, by running parts of one.
resp: Shortlist creators against a brief
Track deliverables and go-live dates
Write first drafts of creator briefs
Sit in on negotiations and take notes that get used
must: Lives on Instagram and YouTube, and can explain why things work
Organised and quick on follow-ups
Available for 6 months, in office
metrics: Shortlists that get approved on the first pass.

title: Brand Partnerships Manager
problem: Start every conversation with the problem, not the pitch.
resp: Build a pipeline of new partnerships
Lead discovery calls that start with the business, not the deck
Own proposals, pricing and closure
Hand over cleanly to Brand Solutions
must: 3+ years in agency or media sales
A record of closed revenue you can talk through
Can read a P&L and a media plan
Calm in a room of CXOs
nice: Experience selling influencer or content work
metrics: Qualified pipeline, win rate and first-year account value.

title: Brand Solutions Executive
problem: Turn a half-formed ask into a plan with dates and numbers on it.
resp: Run day-to-day communication on two to three accounts
Convert briefs into scoped plans, timelines and budgets
Track delivery against promises, with specific dates
Report results a CFO would accept
must: 1+ year in client servicing or account management
Spreadsheets you'd be happy to share
Writes clear, short emails
Under-promises by habit
metrics: On-time delivery and partners who stay.

title: Influencer Relations Executive, South
problem: Build a bench of Tamil, Telugu and Kannada creators people trust.
resp: Discover and vet creators by audience quality, not follower count
Negotiate fair rates and clear deliverables
Keep creators paid on the date we promised
Maintain a creator database the team trusts
must: Fluent in Tamil, Telugu or Kannada
1+ year working with creators or talent
Knows how to read engagement beyond likes
Organised enough to run 30 creators at once
nice: Existing creator network in the South
metrics: Creator quality score, cost per view and repeat-creator rate.

title: Production Executive, TBM Studio
problem: Ship 30 shoots a month without anyone noticing the chaos.
resp: Plan shoots: crew, location, props, permissions, call sheets
Hold budgets and timelines to the rupee and the hour
Run the floor on shoot day
Hand clean footage to post-production
must: 1+ year in ad, film or content production
Can make a call sheet in your sleep
Stays calm when the location falls through
Owns a backup plan for every shoot
metrics: Shoots delivered on time and on budget.

title: Video Editor, Performance
problem: Cut for the first three seconds, because that's all you get.
resp: Edit creator and studio footage for Reels, Shorts and ads
Cut three hook variants for every video
Read retention graphs and re-cut what drops
Keep a clean, shareable project library
must: 2+ years editing short-form or ads
Premiere Pro or Final Cut, plus After Effects basics
A reel with performance numbers if you have them
Fast without being sloppy

title: HR Executive
problem: Hire faster without lowering the bar.
resp: Run hiring end to end: sourcing, screening, interviews, offers
Rebuild the slow steps in our hiring funnel, with data
Own onboarding for every new joiner
Keep the team's pulse, and act on what you hear
must: 1+ year in HR or talent acquisition
Comfort with funnel numbers and simple dashboards
Writes warm, clear, specific emails
Keeps promises to candidates, on time
nice: A background in psychology or org behaviour
metrics: Time-to-hire, offer acceptance rate and 90-day retention.

title: Finance Executive
problem: Make sure every creator is paid on the date we promised. Every time.
resp: Run payables for creators and vendors
Reconcile ledgers and bank every week
Handle GST and TDS filings with our CA
Build a monthly cash view the founders can read in 2 minutes
must: 2+ years in accounts, ideally agency or services
Tally or Zoho Books, and strong Excel
GST and TDS basics
Treats a payment date as a promise
metrics: On-time payments and month-end close in 5 working days.

title: Talent Manager
problem: Grow creators' careers, not only their follower counts.
resp: Manage a roster of 10 to 15 creators
Plan their content, brand deals and growth
Negotiate deals that protect the creator's long-term value
Spot rising creators before they peak
must: 2+ years in talent management or creator partnerships
Strong negotiation record
Understands platform algorithms and audience data
Creators would call you first
metrics: Roster earnings growth and creator retention.
